predictions.text: I predict that the new text and changes for the Chhath Puja page will be finalized and accepted, detailing its deep roots in the cultural traditions of the Indo-Nepalese region.

I predict that herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria will continue, with at least three people killed and several others abducted in new cattle raids and conflicts by the end of Tuesday, 24 November 2026.
I predict that over 50 additional garment factories will close due to worker protests and unrest in Bangladesh.
I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least one more supertanker targeted, possibly struck by a mine or other weapon, involving Iranian forces.
I predict that at least 8 more children will be vaccinated in the next week in Bangladesh.
I predict that three more Palestinians will be killed and over 20 more will be wounded in shelling and shooting attacks by Israeli troops in Khan Younis and other areas of the Gaza Strip.

I predict that the Philippines will sign the Pax Silica deal with the United States, and protests will continue in Metro Manila, with at least 287 people arrested in total by the end of Tuesday, 24 November 2026.
I predict that the executions will take place in Jordan by the end of Tuesday, 24 November 2026.

I predict that the investigation into the Patong fire will reveal that the building's fire safety systems were inadequate, allowing the fire to spread quickly and contributing to the high casualty rate.
I predict that the first joint military exercise takes place in the waters near the Philippine archipelago, involving Australian and Filipino naval forces.
